title: Veronica C Probable NDE 6980
content: As a child I had a terrible longing to see a group of loving beings I called the 'white' people. All I remember is that I once visited them in a place that seemed to have no boundaries. They were an ethereal group in white gossamer robes with no distinct facial features. The area was illuminated with a white light, yet with no obvious physical lighting. I distinctly remember there was something delightful there associated with animals, something I could ride on. A rocking horse is the only way my childish mind could describe it, but it was more magnificent and lion-like. I would ask my mom when I could visit them again, but she never understood what I was talking about. I eventually stopped asking, thinking it was a dream; until, as an adult, my mother introduced me to a man she said saved my life. When I was two, I was strangled by my toddler swing when it tipped upside down while I was still strapped in it. My mother said I turned blue and stopped breathing and she was screaming in panic, not knowing what to do. The neighbor jumped the fence and gave me CPR to revive me. It all made sense after she told me. To this day I can't wear watches without them dying after a while and I still feel intense love when I think about the 'white' people.
